items.t: CVT drive chain can slip and lose power (recall)
items.job: Reprogram CVT software, replace CVT if chain slipped
items.note: Free under recalls 19V-855 and 21V-955. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Windshield cracks with no clear impact
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate EyeSight cameras
items.note: A settlement extended coverage on some years; your insurance glass coverage may also help.

items.t: Windshield chips spread into cracks quickly
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate EyeSight cameras

items.t: Battery drains while parked
items.job: Test for parasitic drain and replace battery
items.note: Extended battery coverage may apply. Finding a module drain can add diagnosis time.

items.t: Leaving the tailgate open runs the battery down
items.job: Test and replace 12-volt battery

items.t: Original battery wears out early
items.job: Replace with higher-capacity 12-volt battery

items.t: Cabin heater ground can melt (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair cabin heater ground
items.note: Free under recall 22V-907. Check the VIN first.

items.t: PCV valve can break apart inside the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace PCV valve
items.note: Free under recall 19V-856. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank low-pressure fuel pump
items.note: Free under recall 21V-587 / 20V-218. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driveshaft center support bolts can loosen (2019 recall)
items.job: Replace driveshaft and support brace
items.note: Free under recall 19V-519. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driveshaft center support bolts can loosen (2023 recall)
items.job: Fit new driveshaft center support bolts
items.note: Free under recall 23V-647. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Body spot welds may be missing near the B-pillar (recall)
items.job: Inspect B-pillar welds
items.note: Free under recall 18V-508. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front tie rod ends may not fit properly (recall)
items.job: Replace front tie rod ends
items.note: Free under recall 21V-954. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front ball joint nut may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten front ball joint nut
items.note: Free under recall 23V-392. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tire beads may be damaged on 20-inch wheels (recall)
items.job: Replace all four tires
items.note: Free under recall 23V-258. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Axle weight rating label is wrong (recall)
items.job: Install corrected certification label
items.note: Free under recall 26V-436. Check the VIN first.

items.t: CVT fluid seepage
items.job: Reseal CVT leak point and top up fluid

items.t: Oil seepage from the PCV hose or oil level switch
items.job: Replace PCV hose or oil level switch seal

items.t: Rattle, knock or squeak from the suspension over bumps
items.job: Replace front struts or suspension bushings per bulletin

items.t: Brake squeak and pulsation
items.job: Replace front pads with updated kit and service rotors

items.t: Rattle under the vehicle when accelerating
items.job: Replace front exhaust pipe

items.t: Rattle from the steering
items.job: Replace electric power steering rack
items.note: Usually done under warranty when it applies.

items.t: Judder when accelerating from low speed or in turns
items.job: Transmission software update and judder repair

items.t: Touchscreen freezes or phone connection drops
items.job: Update head unit software; replace head unit if needed
items.note: Most cars need only the update or a new USB port. A new head unit is the high end.

items.t: Transmission warning with code P0890
items.job: Engine computer software update

items.t: EyeSight brakes or shuts off unexpectedly
items.job: EyeSight camera software update and diagnosis
items.note: A replacement camera or fan costs more if the software update does not fix it.

items.t: Driver side mirror shakes at speed
items.job: Replace driver side mirror assembly
items.note: Some owners report a replacement did not help.
